attributes.name: [Chargeback] Deployment daily spend spike vs. 7-day baseline

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| EVAL threshold_pct_increase = 50.0, min_daily_spend = 25.0, min_spend_currency = "", currency_min_spends = "", filter_deployment = "*"
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND deployment_id IS NOT NULL
| INLINE STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp) BY deployment_id
| WHERE @timestamp >= latest_ts - 7 days
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol, cloud_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, onprem_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_sym = conf_currency_symbol, onprem_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP onprem_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null),
       _c_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)), null),
       _o_has_row = (onprem_rate IS NOT NULL),
       _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_unit)), null),
       _o_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)), null)
| EVAL _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0 AND (_c_sym_u IS NULL OR _c_sym_u == COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR")), TRIM(cloud_sym), null),
       _o_eff_u = CASE(_o_has_row, COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR"), "EUR")
| EVAL _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym)) > 0 AND (_o_sym_u IS NULL OR _o_sym_u == _o_eff_u), TRIM(onprem_sym), null),
       rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(onprem_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)),
       unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, _o_eff_u, COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL currency_symbol = CASE(
    is_onprem_row,
    CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym),
    CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym)
  )
| EVAL units = COALESCE(total_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * rate
| EVAL deployment = COALESCE(deployment_name, deployment_id, "unknown")
| EVAL dep_group = CASE(deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != "", deployment_group, null)
| EVAL day_ts = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, ts)
| STATS day_spend = SUM(cost), day_units = SUM(units), day_deployment = MAX(deployment), day_group = MAX(dep_group), filter_deployment = MAX(filter_deployment), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct_increase), min_spend = MAX(min_daily_spend), cfg_min_curr = MAX(min_spend_currency), cfg_curr_mins = MAX(currency_min_spends), sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "€") BY day_ts, deployment_id, unit
| INLINE STATS latest_day_ts = MAX(day_ts) BY deployment_id
| EVAL is_latest = (day_ts == latest_day_ts)
| EVAL latest_val = CASE(is_latest, day_spend, null), baseline_val = CASE(NOT is_latest, day_spend, null), latest_units_val = CASE(is_latest, day_units, null), latest_deployment = CASE(is_latest, day_deployment, null), latest_group = CASE(is_latest, day_group, null)
| STATS latest_spend = ROUND(MAX(latest_val), 2), baseline_avg = ROUND(AVG(baseline_val), 2), baseline_days = COUNT(baseline_val), units_total = ROUND(MAX(latest_units_val), 2), deployment = COALESCE(MAX(latest_deployment), MAX(day_deployment), deployment_id), all_deployments = VALUES(day_deployment), dep_group = COALESCE(MAX(latest_group), MAX(day_group), "ungrouped"), filter_deployment = MAX(filter_deployment), day = LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(latest_day_ts)), 10), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct), min_spend = MAX(min_spend), cfg_min_curr = MAX(cfg_min_curr), cfg_curr_mins = MAX(cfg_curr_mins), sym = COALESCE(MAX(sym), "€") BY deployment_id, unit
| WHERE filter_deployment == "*" OR deployment == filter_deployment OR MV_CONTAINS(all_deployments, filter_deployment) OR deployment_id == filter_deployment
| WHERE latest_spend IS NOT NULL AND baseline_days > 0 AND baseline_avg > 0.0
| EVAL _cm_entries = MV_APPEND(SPLIT(REPLACE(TO_UPPER(COALESCE(cfg_curr_mins, "")), " ", ""), ","), "_FALLBACK_:0")
| MV_EXPAND _cm_entries
| DISSECT _cm_entries "%{_cm_u}:%{_cm_v}"
| EVAL _matched_min = CASE(_cm_u == unit, TO_DOUBLE(_cm_v), null)
| STATS latest_spend = MAX(latest_spend), baseline_avg = MAX(baseline_avg), baseline_days = MAX(baseline_days), units_total = MAX(units_total), deployment = MAX(deployment), dep_group = MAX(dep_group), day = MAX(day), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct), explicit_min = MAX(_matched_min), min_spend = MAX(min_spend), cfg_min_curr = MAX(cfg_min_curr), sym = MAX(sym) BY deployment_id, unit
| EVAL norm_mcurr = TO_UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(cfg_min_curr, "")))
| EVAL eff_min_spend = COALESCE(explicit_min, CASE(norm_mcurr == "" OR norm_mcurr == unit, min_spend, null))
| WHERE eff_min_spend IS NOT NULL AND latest_spend >= eff_min_spend
| EVAL pct_increase = ROUND((latest_spend - baseline_avg) * 100.0 / baseline_avg, 1)
| WHERE pct_increase > threshold_pct
| SORT pct_increase DESC, latest_spend DESC
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", day, "] Deployment `", deployment, "` (", deployment_id, ", group=", dep_group, ") daily spend spiked +", TO_STRING(pct_increase), "% to ", sym, TO_STRING(latest_spend), " ", unit, " vs. ", TO_STRING(baseline_days), "-day baseline avg of ", sym, TO_STRING(baseline_avg), " ", unit, " (threshold: +", TO_STRING(threshold_pct), "%).")
| KEEP result, day, deployment, deployment_id, dep_group, latest_spend, baseline_avg, pct_increase, threshold_pct, unit
